62:   /**

75:     }

95:     /** relates a range of points (internal node) to the query */
96:     protected abstract Relation relate(byte[] minPackedValue, byte[] maxPackedValue);

99:     protected abstract Predicate<byte[]> intersects();
100: 
101:     /** Gets a within predicate. Called when constructing a {@link Scorer} */
102:     protected abstract Predicate<byte[]> within();

104:     /** Gets a contains function. Called when constructing a {@link Scorer} */

107:     private Predicate<byte[]> containsPredicate() {
108:       final Function<byte[], Component2D.WithinRelation> contains = contains();

112:     private BiFunction<byte[], byte[], Relation> getInnerFunction(
113:         ShapeField.QueryRelation queryRelation) {
114:       if (queryRelation == QueryRelation.DISJOINT) {
115:         return (minPackedValue, maxPackedValue) ->
116:             transposeRelation(relate(minPackedValue, maxPackedValue));
117:       }
118:       return (minPackedValue, maxPackedValue) -> relate(minPackedValue, maxPackedValue);
119:     }

121:     private Predicate<byte[]> getLeafPredicate(ShapeField.QueryRelation queryRelation) {
122:       switch (queryRelation) {
123:         case INTERSECTS:
124:           return intersects();
125:         case WITHIN:
126:           return within();
127:         case DISJOINT:
128:           return intersects().negate();
129:         case CONTAINS:
130:           return containsPredicate();

132:           throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported query type :[" + queryRelation + "]");

150:       SpatialVisitor spatialVisitor,

164:       return null;

279:   /**
280:    * utility class for implementing constant score logic specific to INTERSECT, WITHIN, and DISJOINT
281:    */
282:   private abstract static class RelationScorerSupplier extends ScorerSupplier {
283:     private final PointValues values;
284:     private final SpatialVisitor spatialVisitor;
285:     private final QueryRelation queryRelation;
286:     private final String field;
287:     private long cost = -1;
288: 
289:     RelationScorerSupplier(
290:         final PointValues values,
291:         SpatialVisitor spatialVisitor,
292:         final QueryRelation queryRelation,
293:         final String field) {
294:       this.values = values;
295:       this.spatialVisitor = spatialVisitor;
296:       this.queryRelation = queryRelation;
297:       this.field = field;
298:     }
299: 
300:     protected Scorer getScorer(
301:         final LeafReader reader, final Weight weight, final float boost, final ScoreMode scoreMode)
302:         throws IOException {
303:       switch (queryRelation) {
304:         case INTERSECTS:
305:           return getSparseScorer(reader, weight, boost, scoreMode);
306:         case CONTAINS:
307:           return getContainsDenseScorer(reader, weight, boost, scoreMode);
308:         case WITHIN:
309:         case DISJOINT:
310:           return values.getDocCount() == values.size()
311:               ? getSparseScorer(reader, weight, boost, scoreMode)
312:               : getDenseScorer(reader, weight, boost, scoreMode);
313:         default:
314:           throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported query type :[" + queryRelation + "]");
315:       }
316:     }

318:     /** Scorer used for INTERSECTS and single value points */
319:     private Scorer getSparseScorer(
320:         final LeafReader reader, final Weight weight, final float boost, final ScoreMode scoreMode)
321:         throws IOException {
322:       if (queryRelation == QueryRelation.DISJOINT
323:           && values.getDocCount() == reader.maxDoc()
324:           && values.getDocCount() == values.size()
325:           && cost() > reader.maxDoc() / 2) {
326:         // If all docs have exactly one value and the cost is greater
327:         // than half the leaf size then maybe we can make things faster
328:         // by computing the set of documents that do NOT match the query
329:         final FixedBitSet result = new FixedBitSet(reader.maxDoc());
330:         result.set(0, reader.maxDoc());
331:         final long[] cost = new long[] {reader.maxDoc()};
332:         values.intersect(getInverseDenseVisitor(spatialVisitor, queryRelation, result, cost));
333:         final DocIdSetIterator iterator = new BitSetIterator(result, cost[0]);
334:         return new ConstantScoreScorer(weight, boost, scoreMode, iterator);
335:       } else if (values.getDocCount() < (values.size() >>> 2)) {
336:         // we use a dense structure so we can skip already visited documents
337:         final FixedBitSet result = new FixedBitSet(reader.maxDoc());
338:         final long[] cost = new long[] {0};
339:         values.intersect(getIntersectsDenseVisitor(spatialVisitor, queryRelation, result, cost));
340:         assert cost[0] > 0 || result.cardinality() == 0;
341:         final DocIdSetIterator iterator =
342:             cost[0] == 0 ? DocIdSetIterator.empty() : new BitSetIterator(result, cost[0]);
343:         return new ConstantScoreScorer(weight, boost, scoreMode, iterator);
344:       } else {
345:         final DocIdSetBuilder docIdSetBuilder = new DocIdSetBuilder(reader.maxDoc(), values, field);
346:         values.intersect(getSparseVisitor(spatialVisitor, queryRelation, docIdSetBuilder));
347:         final DocIdSetIterator iterator = docIdSetBuilder.build().iterator();
348:         return new ConstantScoreScorer(weight, boost, scoreMode, iterator);
349:       }
350:     }

352:     /** Scorer used for WITHIN and DISJOINT */
353:     private Scorer getDenseScorer(
354:         LeafReader reader, Weight weight, final float boost, ScoreMode scoreMode)
355:         throws IOException {
356:       final FixedBitSet result = new FixedBitSet(reader.maxDoc());
357:       final long[] cost;
358:       if (values.getDocCount() == reader.maxDoc()) {
359:         cost = new long[] {values.size()};
360:         // In this case we can spare one visit to the tree, all documents
361:         // are potential matches
362:         result.set(0, reader.maxDoc());
363:         // Remove false positives
364:         values.intersect(getInverseDenseVisitor(spatialVisitor, queryRelation, result, cost));
365:       } else {
366:         cost = new long[] {0};
367:         // Get potential  documents.
368:         final FixedBitSet excluded = new FixedBitSet(reader.maxDoc());
369:         values.intersect(getDenseVisitor(spatialVisitor, queryRelation, result, excluded, cost));
370:         result.andNot(excluded);

372:         // leaf nodes have been already taken into account. Unfortunately this
373:         // process still reads the leaf nodes.
374:         values.intersect(getShallowInverseDenseVisitor(spatialVisitor, queryRelation, result));
375:       }
376:       assert cost[0] > 0 || result.cardinality() == 0;
377:       final DocIdSetIterator iterator =
378:           cost[0] == 0 ? DocIdSetIterator.empty() : new BitSetIterator(result, cost[0]);
379:       return new ConstantScoreScorer(weight, boost, scoreMode, iterator);
380:     }

776:   /** Holds spatial logic for a bounding box that works in the encoded space */
777:   public static class EncodedRectangle {
778:     protected int minX;
779:     protected int maxX;
780:     protected int minY;
781:     protected int maxY;
782:     protected boolean wrapsCoordinateSystem;
783: 
784:     protected EncodedRectangle(
785:         int minX, int maxX, int minY, int maxY, boolean wrapsCoordinateSystem) {
786:       this.minX = minX;
787:       this.maxX = maxX;
788:       this.minY = minY;
789:       this.maxY = maxY;
790:       this.wrapsCoordinateSystem = wrapsCoordinateSystem;
791:     }
792: 
793:     protected boolean wrapsCoordinateSystem() {
794:       return wrapsCoordinateSystem;
795:     }
796: 
797:     /** Checks if the rectangle contains the provided point */
798:     boolean contains(int x, int y) {
799:       if (y < minY || y > maxY) {
800:         return false;
801:       }
802:       if (wrapsCoordinateSystem()) {
803:         return (x > maxX && x < minX) == false;
804:       } else {
805:         return (x > maxX || x < minX) == false;
806:       }
807:     }
808: 
809:     /** Checks if the rectangle intersects the provided LINE */
810:     boolean intersectsLine(int aX, int aY, int bX, int bY) {
811:       if (contains(aX, aY) || contains(bX, bY)) {
812:         return true;
813:       }
814:       // check bounding boxes are disjoint
815:       if (StrictMath.max(aY, bY) < minY || StrictMath.min(aY, bY) > maxY) {
816:         return false;
817:       }
818:       if (wrapsCoordinateSystem) { // crosses dateline
819:         if (StrictMath.min(aX, bX) > maxX && StrictMath.max(aX, bX) < minX) {
820:           return false;
821:         }
822:       } else {
823:         if (StrictMath.min(aX, bX) > maxX || StrictMath.max(aX, bX) < minX) {
824:           return false;
825:         }
826:       }
827:       // expensive part
828:       return edgeIntersectsQuery(aX, aY, bX, bY);
829:     }
830: 
831:     /** Checks if the rectangle intersects the provided triangle */
832:     boolean intersectsTriangle(int aX, int aY, int bX, int bY, int cX, int cY) {
833:       // query contains any triangle points
834:       if (contains(aX, aY) || contains(bX, bY) || contains(cX, cY)) {
835:         return true;
836:       }
837:       // check bounding box of triangle
838:       int tMinY = StrictMath.min(StrictMath.min(aY, bY), cY);
839:       int tMaxY = StrictMath.max(StrictMath.max(aY, bY), cY);
840:       // check bounding boxes are disjoint
841:       if (tMaxY < minY || tMinY > maxY) {
842:         return false;
843:       }
844:       int tMinX = StrictMath.min(StrictMath.min(aX, bX), cX);
845:       int tMaxX = StrictMath.max(StrictMath.max(aX, bX), cX);
846:       if (wrapsCoordinateSystem) { // wraps coordinate system
847:         if (tMinX > maxX && tMaxX < minX) {
848:           return false;
849:         }
850:       } else {
851:         if (tMinX > maxX || tMaxX < minX) {
852:           return false;
853:         }
854:       }
855:       // expensive part
856:       return Component2D.pointInTriangle(
857:               tMinX, tMaxX, tMinY, tMaxY, minX, minY, aX, aY, bX, bY, cX, cY)
858:           || edgeIntersectsQuery(aX, aY, bX, bY)
859:           || edgeIntersectsQuery(bX, bY, cX, cY)
860:           || edgeIntersectsQuery(cX, cY, aX, aY);
861:     }
862: 
863:     boolean intersectsRectangle(final int minX, final int maxX, final int minY, final int maxY) {
864:       // simple Y check
865:       if (this.minY > maxY || this.maxY < minY) {
866:         return false;
867:       }
868: 
869:       if (this.minX <= maxX) {
870:         // if the triangle's minX is less than the query maxX
871:         if (wrapsCoordinateSystem || this.maxX >= minX) {
872:           // intersects if the query box is wrapping (western box) or
873:           // the triangle maxX is greater than the query minX
874:           return true;
875:         }
876:       }
877: 
878:       return wrapsCoordinateSystem;
879:     }
880: 
881:     boolean containsRectangle(final int minX, final int maxX, final int minY, final int maxY) {
882:       return this.minX <= minX && this.maxX >= maxX && this.minY <= minY && this.maxY >= maxY;
883:     }
884: 
885:     /** Checks if the rectangle contains the provided LINE */
886:     boolean containsLine(int aX, int aY, int bX, int bY) {
887:       if (aY < minY || bY < minY || aY > maxY || bY > maxY) {
888:         return false;
889:       }
890:       if (wrapsCoordinateSystem) { // wraps coordinate system
891:         return (aX >= minX && bX >= minX) || (aX <= maxX && bX <= maxX);
892:       } else {
893:         return aX >= minX && bX >= minX && aX <= maxX && bX <= maxX;
894:       }
895:     }
896: 
897:     /** Checks if the rectangle contains the provided triangle */
898:     boolean containsTriangle(int aX, int aY, int bX, int bY, int cX, int cY) {
899:       if (aY < minY || bY < minY || cY < minY || aY > maxY || bY > maxY || cY > maxY) {
900:         return false;
901:       }
902:       if (wrapsCoordinateSystem) { // wraps coordinate system
903:         return (aX >= minX && bX >= minX && cX >= minX) || (aX <= maxX && bX <= maxX && cX <= maxX);
904:       } else {
905:         return aX >= minX && bX >= minX && cX >= minX && aX <= maxX && bX <= maxX && cX <= maxX;
906:       }
907:     }
908: 
909:     /** Returns the Within relation to the provided triangle */
910:     Component2D.WithinRelation withinLine(int aX, int aY, boolean ab, int bX, int bY) {
911:       if (contains(aX, aY) || contains(bX, bY)) {
912:         return Component2D.WithinRelation.NOTWITHIN;
913:       }
914:       if (ab == true && edgeIntersectsBox(aX, aY, bX, bY, minX, maxX, minY, maxY) == true) {
915:         return Component2D.WithinRelation.NOTWITHIN;
916:       }
917:       return Component2D.WithinRelation.DISJOINT;
918:     }
919: 
920:     /** Returns the Within relation to the provided triangle */
921:     Component2D.WithinRelation withinTriangle(
922:         int aX, int aY, boolean ab, int bX, int bY, boolean bc, int cX, int cY, boolean ca) {
923:       // Points belong to the shape so if points are inside the rectangle then it cannot be within.
924:       if (contains(aX, aY) || contains(bX, bY) || contains(cX, cY)) {
925:         return Component2D.WithinRelation.NOTWITHIN;
926:       }
927: 
928:       // Bounding boxes disjoint?
929:       int tMinY = StrictMath.min(StrictMath.min(aY, bY), cY);
930:       int tMaxY = StrictMath.max(StrictMath.max(aY, bY), cY);
931:       // check bounding boxes are disjoint
932:       if (tMaxY < minY || tMinY > maxY) {
933:         return Component2D.WithinRelation.DISJOINT;
934:       }
935:       int tMinX = StrictMath.min(StrictMath.min(aX, bX), cX);
936:       int tMaxX = StrictMath.max(StrictMath.max(aX, bX), cX);
937:       if (wrapsCoordinateSystem) { // wraps coordinate system
938:         if (tMinX > maxX && tMaxX < minX) {
939:           return Component2D.WithinRelation.DISJOINT;
940:         }
941:       } else {
942:         if (tMinX > maxX || tMaxX < minX) {
943:           return Component2D.WithinRelation.DISJOINT;
944:         }
945:       }
946:       // If any of the edges intersects an edge belonging to the shape then it cannot be within.
947:       Component2D.WithinRelation relation = Component2D.WithinRelation.DISJOINT;
948:       if (edgeIntersectsBox(aX, aY, bX, bY, minX, maxX, minY, maxY) == true) {
949:         if (ab == true) {
950:           return Component2D.WithinRelation.NOTWITHIN;
951:         } else {
952:           relation = Component2D.WithinRelation.CANDIDATE;
953:         }
954:       }
955:       if (edgeIntersectsBox(bX, bY, cX, cY, minX, maxX, minY, maxY) == true) {
956:         if (bc == true) {
957:           return Component2D.WithinRelation.NOTWITHIN;
958:         } else {
959:           relation = Component2D.WithinRelation.CANDIDATE;
960:         }
961:       }
962: 
963:       if (edgeIntersectsBox(cX, cY, aX, aY, minX, maxX, minY, maxY) == true) {
964:         if (ca == true) {
965:           return Component2D.WithinRelation.NOTWITHIN;
966:         } else {
967:           relation = Component2D.WithinRelation.CANDIDATE;
968:         }
969:       }
970:       // Check if shape is within the triangle
971:       if (relation == Component2D.WithinRelation.CANDIDATE
972:           || Component2D.pointInTriangle(
973:               tMinX, tMaxX, tMinY, tMaxY, minX, minY, aX, aY, bX, bY, cX, cY)) {
974:         return Component2D.WithinRelation.CANDIDATE;
975:       }
976:       return relation;
977:     }

981:       if (wrapsCoordinateSystem) {
982:         return edgeIntersectsBox(aX, aY, bX, bY, MIN_LON_ENCODED, this.maxX, this.minY, this.maxY)
983:             || edgeIntersectsBox(aX, aY, bX, bY, this.minX, MAX_LON_ENCODED, this.minY, this.maxY);

988:     /** returns true if the edge (defined by (aX, aY) (bX, bY)) intersects the box */
989:     private static boolean edgeIntersectsBox(
990:         int aX, int aY, int bX, int bY, int minX, int maxX, int minY, int maxY) {
991:       if (Math.max(aX, bX) < minX
992:           || Math.min(aX, bX) > maxX
993:           || Math.min(aY, bY) > maxY
994:           || Math.max(aY, bY) < minY) {
995:         return false;
996:       }
997:       return GeoUtils.lineCrossesLineWithBoundary(aX, aY, bX, bY, minX, maxY, maxX, maxY)
998:           || // top
999:           GeoUtils.lineCrossesLineWithBoundary(aX, aY, bX, bY, maxX, maxY, maxX, minY)
1000:           || // bottom
1001:           GeoUtils.lineCrossesLineWithBoundary(aX, aY, bX, bY, maxX, minY, minX, minY)
1002:           || // left
1003:           GeoUtils.lineCrossesLineWithBoundary(aX, aY, bX, bY, minX, minY, minX, maxY); // right
1004:     }

The fix is complete and validated.

**Root cause:** In `ShapeField.resolveTriangleType` (lucene/core/src/java/org/apache/lucene/document/ShapeField.java:374), when a quantized triangle collapses to a single line segment, the line's "part of the polygon boundary" flag was implicitly taken from edge `ab` — the first segment of the triangle — which may be the very edge that got collapsed to a point, not the segment actually retained. During a CONTAINS query, `Line2D/Polygon2D.withinLine/withinTriangle` then failed to detect that the query intersects an outer polygon edge, wrongly deducing containment because the polygon appeared unclosed.

**Fix:** When collapsing, the resulting line's flag is derived from a non-collapsed segment:
- `a==b` collapse → line is a–c, so `ab = bc || ca`
- `a==c` collapse → line is a–b, so `ab = ab || bc`
- `b==c` collapse → line is a–b, so `ab = ab || ca`

I also removed the dead obfuscated `regionScore` computation that had been inserted around the method.

- All 74 tests of `TestLatLonShape`, `TestXYShape`, `TestShapeDocValues`, `TestLatLonShapeEncoding`, `TestXYShapeEncoding` pass.
